chunks: We distinguished them for the distinct remembrance of the abode (of the Hereafter).
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah distinguished them with a 'pure remembrance' of the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt, whose spiritual purity (khalisah) is a divine bestowal that distinguishes them from the general community. The 'remembrance of the Hereafter' signifies their constant awareness of the ultimate return to Allah, serving as a model for believers to emulate in their pursuit of nearness to God. This purification is not merely moral but ontological, establishing their unique authority (Wilayah) in guiding the Ummah.
